body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Netgear demonstrated its Skype WiFi Phone ''SPH101'' during 2007 CES Unveiled.

It was introduced at CES 2006 and has been received with international acclaim for its convenient use with a built-in speaker. This year, Netgear adds ''SPH200D'', upgraded Dual-Mode Cordless Phone with Skype, which simultaneously connects to a home network router through Ethernet and a standard telephone wall jack.
Suggested prices for both phones are $199.
